page: Microsoft Azure E48nds_v6 is a memory-optimized virtual machine instance based on the x86_64 Intel processor architecture and managed via Microsoft Hyper-V. The configuration provides 48 dedicated vCPUs alongside 384.0 GB of system memory, maintaining an 8.0 GB memory-to-vCPU ratio. It also features integrated high-speed local storage consisting of 2835 GB across local NVMe SSDs, and is capable of attaching Premium Storage.

Operating without hardware GPU acceleration, the instance concentrates compute and memory resources on high-throughput data processing. The combination of dedicated x86_64 compute cores and substantial memory capacity enables processing large in-memory data structures without frequent paging to disk. The bundled 2835 GB NVMe SSD volume serves as fast scratch space, temporary operational storage, or a high-IOPS cache tier.

From an efficiency perspective, the E48nds_v6 balances dense resource allocation by integrating high-capacity RAM and substantial local NVMe storage within a single provisioned node, mitigating the need for supplementary external temporary disks. Network optimization further assists in maintaining stable throughput across distributed services. The instance is suited for enterprise relational databases, large in-memory caching systems, big data processing pipelines, and memory-intensive analytics workloads.
